title: D2P Command Receipt
description: Outcome of one command (documentType 'd2p:command-receipt', design decision ADR-019). Schema-enforced: 'committed' requires 'eventCursor' and 'revisionRefs' (at least one); 'rejected' requires 'error'; 'accepted-async' requires 'jobId'.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

commandId.description: ID of the command this receipt answers. Informative, not resolved by the referential level.

revisionRefs.description: Pinned revisions created by a committed command: exactly one per affected aggregate. Required when 'status' is 'committed'; omitted when there is nothing to list.

eventCursor.description: Opaque position in the event stream from which the events caused by the command can be read. Required when 'status' is 'committed'.

jobId.description: Job that processes the command asynchronously. Required when 'status' is 'accepted-async'.

error.description: Why the command was rejected. Required when 'status' is 'rejected'.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document (d2p-c14n-v1 over the whole document, excluding 'contentDigest' itself).

extensions.description: Optional extension blocks keyed by extension namespace.

receiptStatus.title: Receipt status
receiptStatus.description: Outcome of a command: 'committed' (new revisions exist), 'rejected' (nothing was written), 'accepted-async' (a job will produce the outcome).
